adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Xavier arrives to stop Scott and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man, who was caught by the mansion's defenses.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's field leader. Called off from a fight with Spider-Man.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor. Calls off the fight with Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Cyclops is in the group (he asks Gambit what Danger Room program was running and orders Jean to shut it down).

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#18
adds.text: When the news shows the mutated Landon draining the city's power, Xavier sends Jean and the X-Men to stop him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's X-Men, sent to stop the mutated Landon.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jean's teacher. Sends the X-Men to stop the mutated Landon.
adds.evidence: Mutants' Revenge (#18): Professor X picks up the news report at the mansion and sends the X-Men in the Blackbird; Jean is with them (Marvel Database notes she is the only X-Man who does not speak). In #17 Jean is sent to the control room to shut down the Danger Room, so it is less clear she is in the group Xavier calls off.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Xavier stops Logan and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man in his mansion, and Logan stays at his side as Xavier hears Spider-Man out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's most unruly X-Man. Called off from a fight with Spider-Man.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Logan's leader. Calls off the fight with Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Wolverine leads the confrontation and speaks during Xavier's talk with Spider-Man ("Watch your mouth pal. Bein' a mutant's a gift.").

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Xavier stops Ororo and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man in his mansion.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's X-Men. Called off from a fight with Spider-Man.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Storm's mentor. Calls off the fight with Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Storm demands to know why Spider-Man came and fights the Danger Room Sentinels.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Xavier stops Rogue and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man in his mansion.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's X-Men. Called off from a fight with Spider-Man.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rogue's mentor. Calls off the fight with Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): the mansion's trap catches Spider-Man, the X-Men confront him in the holding chamber, chase him into the Danger Room, and as they surround him Professor Xavier comes in and orders them to stop, then hears him out. Rogue flirts with the captive Spider-Man and joins the chase.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Testing the Blackbird, Scott takes Logan's call about the missing Beast and tells him to check the lab.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Scott about the missing Beast.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Logan to check the lab for Beast.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): Cyclops and Jubilee test the Blackbird; Wolverine calls from the mansion asking if they have seen Beast, Cyclops tells him to check the lab, and Wolverine says he already has.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Jean sees Logan worrying over the missing Beast and reminds him that everyone hides a private pain.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Worries over the missing Beast. Jean reminds him everyone hides some pain.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Reminds Logan that everyone hides a private pain.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): Jean asks why Wolverine is so worried about Beast; he says Beast has been acting strange; Jean says everyone has a private pain they keep hidden and he of all people should understand.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: When Jubilee begs Spider-Man to stay, Logan tells her to forget it, since he is too much of a loner.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wants Spider-Man to stay. Logan waves it off.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Jubilee that Spider-Man is too much of a loner.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): Jubilee: "Spider-Man, don't go. He could be a big help to us." Wolverine: "Forget it. He's too much of a loner."

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: When Rogue flirts with the trapped Spider-Man, Logan moves her aside to threaten him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Flirts with Spider-Man until Logan moves her aside.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Moves Rogue aside to threaten Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: The Mutant Agenda (#17): in the holding chamber Rogue walks up to Spider-Man and flirts with him; Wolverine moves Rogue out of the way and threatens him.

adds.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
adds.text: Xavier stops Remy and the X-Men from fighting Spider-Man, who stumbled into the Danger Room Remy left running.

owner_calls.question: In Spider-Man (1994)#17-18 the X-Men act as one team (the holding chamber, the Danger Room fight, the Blackbird mission against Landon). Teammates with no exchange of their own (Rogue and Gambit, Jean and Rogue, Jean and Storm, Cyclops and Storm, Gambit and Jubilee) are marked none. Should a shared team scene count as dealing with each other?
options: Keep as none (no exchange between the two)
Add a team stage for each pair at Spider-Man (1994)#17
owner_calls.evidence: The Mutant Agenda: the X-Men step out together, chase Spider-Man and "work together to defeat" the Danger Room Sentinels; Mutants' Revenge: the X-Men arrive in the Blackbird and fight Landon together.
